_README: Hand-labelled field truth for the four REAL tender notifications, for
Every value here was read off the source PDF by a human, NOT copied from
the system's own output. Copying the output would make the metric
circular -- it would measure self-consistency and report it as accuracy.
Fields a labeller could not confirm in the source are OMITTED rather than
guessed. The evaluator counts them as 'unlabelled' and excludes them from
the denominator, so coverage is reported alongside accuracy and a thin
label set cannot masquerade as a strong result.
`rule` says how a prediction is compared, because exact string equality is
the wrong test for several of these fields: an issuing authority written
in expanded form ('Indian Institute of Technology ... Dhanbad') is a
correct reading of 'IIT (ISM) Dhanbad', and failing it would understate
real accuracy as badly as accepting anything would overstate it.
